title: See which AI sent it
summary: In a pursuit, everything an AI added or shared shows which AI sent it, with its mark, and a file's Download saves one copy.

payload.title: Which AI sent it
payload.body: When ChatGPT, Claude, Muse or any AI you connected posts or shares something in a pursuit, its name and mark now sit beside yours, so everyone can see which AI sent it.

payload.title: Open a pursuit
payload.body: In Messages, the Table's From column lets you sort and group by which AI sent each thing. Open a file to read it right there. Download saves it once, and the button shows Downloading while it works.
